name: Páhi (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and green in the ratio 1:5:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Páhi (a shield of yellow, green and blue with a bunch of grapes, a windmill and a bell, between ears of grain) below the name PÁHI in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
